bio.text: Gregg Haddad was first elected to the Connecticut General Assembly in 2010 and represents the 54th District, which includes Mansfield.
He chaired the Higher Education & Employment Advancement Committee for the 2023-2024 session and serves on the Government Administration & Elections and Appropriations committees.
Before being elected, he spent 11 years on the Mansfield Town Council, serving as Deputy Mayor.
He chairs the New England Board of Higher Education.
